scope: raw original European Track01, first 48 MiB
method: search for a fixed-width 4-country contiguous name bank RUSSIA,UKRAINE,TURKEY,GREECE using a single unknown bijective 1-byte glyph code; record strides 8,10,12,16,20,24,32
limitation: Does not exclude variable-length records, compressed strings, non-bijective codes, rendering from edit data or other sources.
